findings.evidence: registry.scope specifies 'a dynamic plugin registry with runtime-discovered ... loaders, a hot-reload config watcher ..., and a multi-backend provider abstraction (sqlite/yaml/json backends)' to support the 'single iteration-plan constraints-profile'. Three backends and a plugin system for one profile is speculative generality with no second consumer.
findings.suggestion: Drop to a static registry + one backend; reintroduce plugins/hot-reload/multi-backend only when a second profile or backend actually exists.
